## ChargeCall 1.7.0

**New**
- In-app updates: when opened, ChargeCall checks for a new version and offers to install it. The APK is downloaded from the GitHub releases page with progress in a notification, continues where it stopped if the connection drops, is checked against its SHA-256 and opened in the Android installer. Settings has a switch for the automatic check and a "Check now" button.
- Animated splash screen (Android 12+).

**Fixes**
- Restoring a backup on the same phone no longer deletes the voice recordings it just restored.
- Rotating or resizing the rule editor no longer throws away unsaved edits and a new recording.
- After a backup import, monitoring immediately uses the imported rules.
- Tapping "Stop sound" on an old alert no longer turns monitoring back on after it was switched off.
- The Quick Settings tile opens the app instead of crashing when Android refuses to start monitoring from the panel.
- An alert whose voice the speech engine refuses no longer keeps other apps' audio lowered.
- Backup import is safer: size limits, recordings only replaced after the backup is valid, rule values limited to valid ranges.
- Deleting a rule also deletes its recording.

Note: this version adds the internet permission, used only for the update check and download. There are still no ads and no tracking.
Users of 1.6.1 install 1.7.0 by hand once; later updates are offered in the app.

## ChargeCall 1.6.1

First public release of ChargeCall — talking battery alerts, without ads.

**Alerts as automations**
- Rules: battery drops to X%, reaches X% while charging, full, charger connected/disconnected, temperature, slow charging, temperature rising fast, battery not increasing, plugged in at 100% too long (overnight charging), battery health below X%, charge cycles reach X.
- Sounds: AI voice (device text-to-speech, with phrases that use {level}, {temp}, {status}, {time}, {time_left}, {health}), your own recording, an audio file, a ringtone, or vibrate only. Volume, pitch, speech rate, repeat count, loop for N seconds, repeat every N minutes.
- Extra conditions per rule: hours, days of the week, charger type (AC/USB/wireless), profile. Profiles (Home, Work, Sleep, …) switch sets of rules with one tap.
- Stays silent while the phone is in use (optional per rule), quiet hours, Mute for 1 hour, and a Stop sound button in the notification.

**Battery**
- Battery health: current full capacity vs design capacity, charge cycles, status, voltage. With Shizuku it uses the capacity Android learned; without it, an estimate from the charge counter.
- Time estimates: "Full in …" while charging, "About … left" on battery.
- History: battery level chart (24 h / 7 days), charging sessions, battery health trend.

**Convenience**
- Home-screen widget with level, status, estimate, health and a Mute button; Quick Settings tiles "Battery monitor" and "Mute ChargeCall".
- Backup & restore of rules, profiles, settings and recordings to a .zip file.
- Setup guide that checks notification permission, battery optimisation, Xiaomi Autostart and battery saver, alarm volume and the text-to-speech voice.
- Follows the device language (English, Indonesian). Light on memory: the background service uses about 12 MB.

Requires Android 10+. No internet permission. Shizuku is optional (battery health only).
